maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is insurance premiums for auto, home and commercial policies, not repair or maintenance of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Premiums come from private consumers and small and mid-sized businesses buying auto, home and commercial coverage through independent agents.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by writing more policies through independent agents; acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Personal and small-business property-casualty policies renew annually and can be moved to another insurer via agents fairly easily.

notes: Insurance is protective, so mission-critical is a judgment call; switching carriers is routine.
